messages:
Lina: FYI I opened a docs PR to add a `capabilities` field to the model-catalog index (so we can filter variants by features like streaming, tool-calls, cpu-quant). Also included a tiny migration note for legacy quant names. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1522

docs-bot: PR #1522 opened by Lina (model-catalog: add capabilities + quant-name migration)

Omar: Thanks. Can we be explicit about hardware and measurement conditions if we publish throughput rows? e.g. label as 'measured on A10G with perf-harness v2, exclusive GPU, kv-cache warmed'.

Priya: Good call. I added two throughput columns (throughput@1024, throughput@4096) and a short note with that exact wording. Also added a tiny SDK snippet showing streaming + explicit fallback to a cpu-quant variant:

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate("Summarize this doc...", model="glacier4b", stream=True, fallback_model="glacier4b-cpu-quant")
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

Jules: I added a simple mapping table in the migration section so customers can search/replace. Example lines: "legacy_quant -> glacier4b-quant-v1", "legacy_small -> glacier4b-cpu-quant".

Jules: Also suggested a safe preview one-liner for ripgrep users: `rg "legacy_quant" -n | cut -d: -f1 | uniq | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "---- {}"; sed -n "1,5p" {}; read -p "Replace? (y/N)" a; ["$a" = "y"] && sed -i "s/legacy_quant/glacier4b-quant-v1/g" {}'` (marked advanced).

Lina: Please add a short FAQ blurb: "Why do variant throughput/latency numbers differ?" and point to runtime docs about batching, kernel selection, and KV cache effects.

Priya: Added the FAQ and linked to https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/batching. Also normalized variant IDs to lowercase in the index and added `capabilities: streaming,tool-calls,cpu-quant` where applicable.

Omar: Quick editorial nit: use 'MB' for memory units and ensure bench link points to canonical shot.

Priya: Fixed units and updated bench url to https://bench.redwood/shots/59021 with harness seed=42.

docs-bot: PR #1522 merged by Lina  commit 9f1b7c2. Docs deploy scheduled for 2026-04-08 21:30 UTC :rocket:
